explanation: Exchanging business cards is a standard and important part of formal business introductions in Mexico, and cards are typically given to everyone present at a meeting. Including a Spanish translation on one side and presenting that side facing the recipient is considered courteous. Cards often carry professional titles and qualifications, reflecting the status-conscious nature of Mexican business culture.
local_tip: Bring plenty of cards with Spanish on one side and your cellphone number included, and hand them out to everyone present, Spanish side facing the recipient.

also_check.note: Card exchange is highly ritualized; present and receive with both hands and study the card carefully.
Offer and receive cards with both hands, often with a slight bow, and present the Chinese side up.
Common but casual; a brief handshake and quick card swap is usually sufficient.
